summary: Re-tested the paywall 'Subscription options are unavailable right now' bug fix from iteration_3.json. Ran 4 separate fresh page loads of /paywall (3 automated + 1 with PIN unlock for visual confirmation). In all 4 attempts, the offeringsQuery correctly detected the RevenueCat SDK resolving with an empty availablePackages array (console log: 'Empty offerings... Could not find product data for product ids: pro.basic_monthly,pro.adfree_monthly,pro.premium_monthly') and fell back to buildMockOfferings(), rendering all 3 plan cards (Basic ₹29, Ad-Free ₹59, Premium ₹99) with the 'Preview mode — plans shown are simulated' banner. The 'Subscription options are unavailable right now' banner (testID paywall-unavailable) never appeared. Bug is FIXED and consistently reproducible as fixed (no flakiness observed).
critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx offeringsQuery.queryFn now correctly checks resolvedOffering?.availablePackages?.length after a successful getOfferings() resolve, in addition to the existing catch-block fallback on exception/timeout. This closes the gap identified in iteration_3.

No regressions found: Restore Purchases button works (shows 'Purchases restored.' message via mock fallback), close button (paywall-close-btn) renders correctly when trial is active ('Free trial • 14 days left' header text shown), and legal text at bottom renders as expected.

Buy buttons (buy-btn-basic/adfree/premium) are correctly disabled (grey) because identityReady is false (no signed-in Google account in this test) - this is expected behavior per the 'Sign in with Google in Settings first' banner, not a regression.

success_rate.backend: N/A - frontend only testing per request
success_rate.frontend: 100% - paywall fix verified across 4 attempts, no regressions in restore/close/legal text

context_for_next_testing_agent: Paywall offeringsQuery empty-packages fallback bug (from iteration_3) is confirmed FIXED and stable across repeated fresh loads. Did not test the actual purchase/confirm flow end-to-end since buy buttons are disabled pending Google sign-in (identityReady=false), which is expected/unchanged behavior and out of scope for this fix. No new issues found.
